task_instance: Rebuild a weak $1,500 flat-fee 'SEO Audit' PDF offer into a complete offer using the skill's value-equation diagnosis and six-component anatomy (core deliverable, bonus stack, guarantee, scarcity/urgency, name, price+payment structure), for a sample productized-service business fixture created in the work directory.
evidence: Created business-input.md as a small realistic sample business (agency selling a $1,500 flat-fee SEO audit PDF, 8% call conversion, no bonuses/guarantee/scarcity). Followed the skill's Diagnostic Loop verbatim in offer-rebuild.md: (1) identified business type, (2) stated current offer plainly, (3) scored the four value-equation levers (dream outcome 4, perceived likelihood 2, time delay 6, effort/sacrifice 2) and identified the binding constraints, (4) audited all six anatomy components against the current offer, (5) picked the lever/structural change to fix, (6) drafted the new offer 'Ranking Fix Sprint' with all six components filled in (audit+implementation sprint as deliverable, 2 additive bonuses, a conditional performance guarantee, real capacity-based scarcity, a renamed offer, and a 50/50 payment structure at a new price), (7) gave an honest 10-40% lift projection per the skill's explicit anti-hype guidance instead of an inflated multiple. Verified programmatically with grep that all six anatomy-component headers/terms are present in the rebuilt offer, and that none of the skill's banned vocabulary terms (game-changing, revolutionary, disruptive, next-level, 10x, secret, hidden, unconditioned '100% guaranteed') appear as actual claims in the offer body -- the one match for '100% guaranteed' was confirmed by manual line inspection to be an explicit contrast ('not 100% guaranteed') describing what was avoided, not a claim made. No network access, installs, or non-shell tools were needed; the skill is a pure reasoning/writing framework applied to a text deliverable, fully achievable in this offline runtime. Files produced: business-input.md, offer-rebuild.md, result.json.
